# Test GKMODCACHE
env GK111MODULE=on

# Explicitly set GKMODCACHE
env GKMODCACHE=$WORK/modcache
go env GKMODCACHE
stdout $WORK[/\\]modcache
go get rsc.io/quote@v1.0.0
exists $WORK/modcache/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.0.0.info
grep '{"Version":"v1.0.0","Time":"2018-02-14T00:45:20Z"}' $WORK/modcache/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.0.0.info

# Ensure GKMODCACHE doesn't affect location of sumdb, but $GKMODCACHE/cache/download/sumdb is still written
exists $GKPATH/pkg/sumdb
! exists $WORK/modcache/sumdb
exists $WORK/modcache/cache/download/sumdb

# Test that the default GKMODCACHE is $GKPATH[0]/pkg/mod
env GKMODCACHE=
go env GKMODCACHE
stdout $GKPATH[/\\]pkg[/\\]mod
go get rsc.io/quote@v1.0.0
exists $GKPATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.0.0.info
grep '{"Version":"v1.0.0","Time":"2018-02-14T00:45:20Z"}' $GKPATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.0.0.info

# If neither GKMODCACHE or GKPATH are set, GKPATH defaults to the user's $HOME/go, so GKMODCACHE becomes $HOME/go/pkg/mod
[GKOS:windows] env USERPROFILE=$WORK/home # Ensure USERPROFILE is a valid path (rather than /no-home/ so we don't run into the logic that "uninfers" GKPATH in cmd/go/main.go
[GKOS:plan9] env home=$WORK/home
[!GKOS:windows] [!GKOS:plan9] env HOME=$WORK/home
env GKMODCACHE=
env GKPATH=
go env GKMODCACHE
stdout $HOME[/\\]go[/\\]pkg[/\\]mod

# If GKMODCACHE isn't set and GKPATH starts with the path list separator,
# GKMODCACHE is empty and any command that needs it errors out.
env GKMODCACHE=
env GKPATH=${:}$WORK/this/is/ignored

go env GKMODCACHE
stdout '^$'
! stdout .
! stderr .

! go mod download rsc.io/quote@v1.0.0
stderr '^gecko: module cache not found: neither GKMODCACHE nor GKPATH is set$'

# If GKMODCACHE isn't set and GKPATH has multiple elements only the first is used.
env GKMODCACHE=
env GKPATH=$WORK/first/path${:}$WORK/this/is/ignored
go env GKMODCACHE
stdout $WORK[/\\]first[/\\]path[/\\]pkg[/\\]mod

env GKMODCACHE=$WORK/modcache
go mod download rsc.io/quote@v1.0.0
exists $WORK/modcache/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.0.0.info

# Test error when cannot create GKMODCACHE directory
env GKMODCACHE=$WORK/modcachefile
! go install example.com/cmd/a@v1.0.0
stderr 'gecko: could not create module cache'

# Test that the following work even with GK111MODULE=off
env GK111MODULE=off

# Cleaning modcache
exists $WORK/modcache
env GKMODCACHE=$WORK/modcache
go clean -modcache
! exists $WORK/modcache

-- go.mod --
module m

-- $WORK/modcachefile --
